capabilities.notes: Track enterprise bring-your-own-key design, custody boundaries, tenant key lifecycle, revocation, and support policy before marketing BYOK.
Track device risk scoring inputs, score bands, policy hooks, operator visibility, and false-positive review for device-heavy customer flows.
Track anomaly detection for impossible travel, OTP abuse, credential stuffing, provider callback spikes, and suspicious admin actions.
Track session forensics tooling for incident timelines, session family history, revocation lineage, device changes, and support-safe inspection.
Track fine-grained authorization beyond simple roles, including resource scopes, policy evaluation, audit visibility, and customer namespace isolation.
Track enterprise compliance packaging such as SOC 2 evidence, HIPAA support materials, DPA/privacy artifacts, and customer security review exports.
